# eventmodeling fixtures

- `inline-data.mmd`, `data-blocks.mmd`, `namespaces.mmd`, `read-model.mmd`:
  the playground samples on the ondine documentation site
  (https://ondine.sh, wevm/ondine, MIT), used as syntax references only;
  the grammar follows the Mermaid event modeling page
  (https://mermaid.js.org/syntax/eventmodeling.html).
- `cjk.mmd`, `minimal.mmd`: written for this engine (CJK names, every
  entity kind, typed inline data, a namespaced reset frame with an explicit
  relation).
